capabilities: Create Linear issues from notes using inline tags like @team/, @assignee/, and @label/
Sync Linear issues, statuses, and comments bidirectionally into vault notes
Autocomplete Linear users, statuses, labels, projects, and teams while typing tags
Generate kanban boards and agenda notes from Linear issues
Resolve sync conflicts and run batch create/update operations across notes
extras: Installation is manual via GitHub Releases rather than through the community plugin store; webhooks and Slack/Discord notifications are listed as roadmap items, not current features.
problem: Obsidian has no way to create, update, or track Linear issues from notes, so users must switch to Linear and keep issue data in sync manually.

relations.evidence: A comprehensive Linear integration plugin for Obsidian that provides seamless bidirectional synchronization

summary: Bidirectional sync plugin that connects Obsidian notes to Linear issues, with inline tags, autocomplete, and issue management.
